titles.romaji: Kimekoi! Takane no Hana to Osananajimi ga Kimatta Riyuu
titles.native: キメ恋！ 高嶺の華と幼なじみがキマった理由

description:
Expressing love is very heavy, for fear of rejection. Hajime asks Misa for help making Love Drugs for Megumi, so that her love statement goes successfully. Unexpectedly the Love Drug has the effect of making Megumi feel itchy and wanting to have sex while remembering Hajime. Can Hajime declare his love? Or is there any other purpose of this drug?

(Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated)
